appraisal_events.explanation: After the narrator is seen conversing with Mme de Villeparisis, princesse Sherbatoff coldly withdraws her favor and permanently cuts him off, staging him as a participant who is abruptly excluded from her goodwill.

ambiguities: princesse Sherbatoff, central to the narrator's snub in this passage, is not on the candidate list, so only her role as source of an event targeting the candidate le narrateur is recorded; her own status is not scored here.

The mentions of 'duc de Guermantes' in Mme Verdurin's planning speech ('c'est peut-être un imbécile du Jockey') sit oddly against the preceding extended discussion of the prince de Guermantes' visit; it is unclear whether this is the duc himself or a textual variant referring to the prince, so no event was recorded for duc de Guermantes given this uncertainty and the joking, glancing nature of the remark.
